card.name: The number five in ratios and thresholds
card.fires_on: The number 5 or the word five after 'in', '>' or '≥', as in 'one in five' or '>5 times ULN'. It also fires on 'and' inside a statistic list.

modes.label: Five as a lab threshold
modes.description: The digit 5 after > or ≥ in liver enzyme limits expressed as times the upper limit of normal.
modes.example: ALT or AST ><<5>> times the ULN occurred in 1

modes.label: One in five
modes.description: The word five or digit 5 after 'one in' or '1 in' when stating a proportion of people.
modes.example: Only one in<< five>> patients who develop a serious upper GI adverse

modes.label: And in a statistic
modes.description: The word 'and' joining numbers in a trial result sentence.
